avis.titre: 5 Stars for Borghese: Luxurious Elegance in a Bottle
avis.texte: You can sense the quality of a Borghese product from the moment you open it. I recently tried their revitalizing face serum, and I am beyond impressed! The packaging exudes sophistication and hints at the luxurious experience within. The serum itself is a testament to Borghese's commitment to quality and elegance. It glides on smoothly, leaving my skin feeling rejuvenated and radiant. The formula is rich with natural ingredients that visibly improve skin texture and hydration levels without feeling heavy. What I love the most is how my skin feels supple and glowing after each use. Borghese continues to uphold their reputation for high-quality, effective skincare, making every application a pampering ritual. Highly recommended for anyone looking to indulge in a little luxury in their skincare routine!

avis.titre: Fango is the best thing I have ever used on my skin
avis.texte: I started using Fango (I think - not sure of exact date) in the 1980s. I went into a store, the woman put some on the back of my hand, we chatted for a moment, she washed it off, my skin was AMAZING! I have a very bad skin condition for which there is not much that can be done. I bought a bunch of Fango and I would put it all over my body and wear it for at least six hours (except only 10-15 minutes on my face). Then I would scrub it off. Pretty soon I did not have that horrible skin disease any longer. When I went to see my dermatologist, the first thing he said was 'WHAT DID YOU DO TO YOUR SKIN?' I asked if it was bad and he said NO, Your skin has never looked this amazing. That is a true story. So I use Fango on a regular basis! Borghese has the best products. People tell me my skin looks great and Fango is the reason why. The disease I have is HS - but it doesn't bother me much since I began using Fango.

I love, love, love this mask! Makes my skin feel clean, tightened and supple! I take the back side of an ice tea spoon to get the fango mud mask out and use the spoon to smooth it over my face! It's not only very effective, but less messy on your hands and feels very cool to my face! Oh, did I mention I love the mask! I used this mask years ago and loved it then!
